description: Steps rise in one after another, a running title has a light passing through it, a finished step's tick pops in and draws itself, and a row opens to its real height with its detail cascading in.
moves: Lines rise in one after another as they arrive.
A running title has a soft light passing through it; it stops for reduced motion.
When a step finishes, its tick pops in and draws itself.
A row that expands opens to its real height.
The detail's paragraphs rise in one after another as it opens.
The chevron turns down on a spring.
keyboard: Moves to the next row that expands, or link.
Opens or closes the focused row.

propDocs.TraceLine.status: "running", "error" or "pending". Leave it out once the step is done.
propDocs.TraceIcon.children: Your own icon. Without one, the icon shows the line's status.
